messages:
maria-sales: Heads-up — enterprise POC on Dedicated hitting inconsistent JSON when chaining two tool calls in a single request. Customer says sometimes the second tool's JSON gets appended raw and parsing fails client-side. They're blocked for tomorrow's demo.

tony-eng: Can you attach the request ids + whether they used streaming or not? Also model and any custom quantization flags?

maria-sales: Request IDs: `req_9b2f11` and `req_9b2f12`. Model: rwd-compat-7b-v3-qt8. They had json_mode=true and stream=true. Client error: `ValueError: Extra data: line 1 column 345` when calling json.loads on the received stream.

anya-ml: Streaming with fncalls can produce multiple JSON objects in one TCP stream. If the client expects a single JSON document, a 429 mid-stream or chunk boundary can leave a partial second document causing "Extra data".

nina-se: Customer also asked about whether intermediate tool outputs are written to disk or S3 on Dedicated. They need an answer for their security questionnaire (data flow + retention).

quota-bot: rate-limiter: customer-ent-17 - allocated_qps: 20, used: 20, reset_in: 18s

tony-eng: Looking at traces (trace-id: t-03-2026-03-20-4c9). We see: 200 chunked response for tool A, then a 429 for tool B which returns a short 429 chunk. The client concatenated the chunks and attempted to parse as one JSON doc.

anya-ml: Short-term recommendations: 1) Set stream=false for the POC so the client gets fully-formed JSON per call. 2) If they need streaming, modify client to parse NDJSON / length-prefixed messages and expect multiple top-level JSON objects. We'll prepare an SDK example for both patterns.

maria-sales: Customer asked for exact SDK snippet and whether we can toggle per-request so they don't have to change all clients. They want an easy flag for the POC.

tony-eng: We support request-level `stream` toggle — tell them to pass `stream: false` in the generate call. I'll also propose bumping their Dedicated QPS for the demo window; ops needs approval.

nina-se: For the QSA: Dedicated config note — control plane stores metadata, inference nodes handle transient tool outputs in-memory; by default no persistent object store is used. KMS: customer-managed keys supported for Dedicated. I'll draft the QSA blurb and send to legal for review.

maria-sales: Also, they're seeing odd replacement characters (�) and sometimes a leading BOM (EF BB BF) at the start of tool outputs when the tool calls an external vendor API. Could be an upstream encoding issue.

anya-ml: We can sanitize by stripping BOM bytes at ingest. Quick patch: preproc step in SDK/runtime to drop leading UTF-8 BOM. I'll open a PR and get a staging canary.

canary-bot: deploy: candidate/strip-bom -> staging (job 2621) queued

tony-eng: Follow-up bug: ensure streaming framing uses explicit boundaries when multiple tool responses are emitted so clients can safely stream-parse. I'll file internal issue and add tests for interleaved chunk scenarios.

maria-sales: I'll tell customer: (1) immediate workaround: stream=false for POC; (2) ops can temporarily increase QPS for demo window; (3) we're shipping a BOM-strip patch to staging with ETA ~ 4h and will follow up re: framing fix and QSA doc. Scheduling a call to walk them through change — proposed 10:30 PT.

nina-se: If they need signed attestation for the POC, ping me and I'll add the Dedicated isolation note.

maria-sales: Thanks all, sending workaround now and closing loop after staging verifies. :white_check_mark:
